Bill.BriefDescription: Permitting leave sharing policies for local government employers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to leave sharing policies for local governmentemployers; amending RCW 41.35.010 and 41.40.010; and adding a newsection to chapter 41.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any county, municipality, or other political subdivision of thestate that offers its employees paid leave for vacation, injuries,illness, bereavement, emergencies, or personal holidays may establisha leave sharing policy. The leave sharing policy must permit employeesto voluntarily transfer leave to a fellow employee who is sufferingfrom, or has a relative suffering from, an extraordinary or severeillness, injury, impairment, or physical or mental condition, which hascaused or is likely to cause the employee to take leave without pay orterminate his or her employment. The leave sharing policy must includeeligibility criteria for employees to transfer or receive leave.
